newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso mixed to firmer on light dlr inflow.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso mixed to firmer on light dlr inflow.

text.p: The Mexican peso was mixed at mid-morning trade on Tuesday, but longer contracts extended early strength on moderate capital flow into the local stock and money markets, dealers said.
"I feel the peso has firmed on domestic and foreign players positioning themselves ahead of this evening's primary securities auction," a dealer said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart both stood 0.9 of a centavo firmer, respectively, at 7.9140/7.9160 and 7.9090/7.9130 per dollar.
Same-day peso contracts had meanwhile closed trade for the day 1.2 centavos weaker at 7.9080/7.9110 per dollar after lining up with longer contracts.
Demand in the money market had driven down overnight Cetes rates by 60 basis points to 19.15 percent, while the Mexican bourse's blue chip IPC index had gained 26.16 points to 4,767.40.
